content.name: Oil of Taggit
entries: A creature subjected to this poison must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition poisoned} for 24 hours. The {@condition poisoned} creature is {@condition unconscious}. The creature wakes up if it takes damage.

content.name: Oil of Taggit
entries: A creature subjected to Oil of Taggit must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition for 24 hours. The creature also has the {@condition Unconscious|SRD52} condition while {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} in this way. It wakes up if it takes damage.
